# Browser libraries

These local copies let EventPilot start without a connection to an external CDN.

| Library | Version | Distribution source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chart.js | 4.5.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js | LICENSE.chartjs.md |
| marked | 15.0.12 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.12/marked.min.js | LICENSE.marked.md |
| DOMPurify | 3.2.6 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.2.6/dist/purify.min.js | LICENSE.dompurify.txt |
| qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js | LICENSE.qrcode.txt |
| html5-qrcode | 2.3.8 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html5-qrcode@2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js | LICENSE.html5-qrcode.txt |

Distribution license notices are retained. Serve this directory alongside index.html.
